test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Concede
solution: The correct answer is '**Permit**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Concede**' is '**Permit**'. • **Concede**: to admit that something is true although you do not want to. (किसी सचाई को न चाहते हुए भी मान लेना; स्‍वीकार करना) • *Example: When it was clear that he would lose the election, he **conceded** defeat.* • **Permit**: to allow somebody to do something or to allow something to happen. (किसी बात की अनुमति देना या कोई बात होने देना) • *Example: You are not **permitted** to smoke in the hospital.* **Correct Answer:__** *Permit.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Reject**: to refuse to accept somebody/something. [व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को अस्‍वीकार करना (मानने से इनकार करना)] • **Deny**: to state that something is not true; to refuse to admit or accept something. (किसी बात से इनकार करना; किसी बात को नकारना) • **Fascinate**: to attract or interest somebody very much. (आकृष्‍ट करना या रुचि जगाना; मोहित करना) 34:Tc57, The correct answer is '**resist**'.
